race.comment: REBEL TUESDAY (4) was beaten under a length by CZECH OUT two back over 1100m at this track when she carried the same weight as today's rival. Disappointed last time but plummets to 54.5kgs today and should enjoy an extra 100m at this stage of the campaign. Great chance to return to her best. NEVER ORDINARY (2) led and just failed to hold out CZECH OUT when they clashed three weeks ago over 1100m here. That followed a five-week break so she strips fitter. Gets the run of the race from gate one and will be hard to stop. VANDAROSS (5) backs up seven days after being beaten under a length over 1250m at the Parks circuit. Going well and the addition of blinkers today could give him that extra edge. CZECH OUT (1) has been busy of late and is really flying, beating many of today's chief rivals in recent weeks. Great weight carrier who cannot be underestimated. SIDEBAR (9) was edged out last Saturday in a career-best performance. Definite contender with the light weight.
